purpose: Measure actual routed-expert overlap before considering grouped MoE changes
runtime: Installed b11756 plus upstream proposals 30380 and 30640; only a temporary diagnostic llama.dll differs
model: Original Flash-Next UD-IQ4_XS target, Q4_K external draft, MTP3, ub512, dynamic draft vocabulary 16384
sampling: Greedy, seed 1234, ignore EOS, reasoning off, naturally exiting single-turn CLI

capture.mechanism: Existing scheduler evaluation callback; request only ffn_moe_topk tensors, skip model warmup
capture.context_identity: Record the existing target/MTP context type
capture.layout: Record tensor name, token count and strides; copy all ten selected expert IDs per token with the actual row stride
capture.bounds: I32 tensors, ten selected experts, up to 512 tokens, up to 512 experts, at most 1 MiB readback
capture.excluded: No hardware counters, elevation, driver policy change, raw model weights or production deployment

metrics: Unique experts per verification batch and layer
Duplicate expert selections across tokens irrespective of rank
Duplicate expert selections restricted to the same rank across tokens
analysis.requirement: Validate complete ordered layer groups and ID ranges; retain incomplete or failed captures as failures rather than filling missing records
analysis.opportunity_gate: Consider global grouping only if cross-token duplicate selections reach 20% on both prompts' four-token target batches; this is triage, not a speed prediction

limitations: The callback segments graph execution and synchronizes readback, so timings are not benchmark results
Expert-selection duplication is not measured DRAM traffic; cache reuse may already avoid physical reloads
These are two existing development prompts, not representative independent quality validation
Single-sequence observations do not validate rollback or multi-sequence execution
